company_facts: Correct name and spelling: PlanNet Marketing (capital P, capital N). Not 'Planet Marketing'. Site: plannetmarketing.com. HQ listed at 260 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta GA.

PlanNet is the direct-selling (network marketing) arm that sells the InteleTravel home-based Independent Travel Agency (ITA). In the US, people who want to become an InteleTravel agent enroll through a PlanNet rep. Source: hostagencyreviews.com/blog/travel-mlms

So there are TWO products: (1) travel itself, booked through Jessica as an InteleTravel travel advisor (her booking site / personal service), and (2) the business opportunity: becoming an InteleTravel agent and/or a PlanNet rep.
In the UK, PlanNet sells a travel membership called the Society of Intelligent Travelers. Source: behindmlm.com PlanNet review
InteleTravel says it has about 145,000 travel advisors worldwide (July 2026), with a booking platform of 110+ suppliers. Sources: hostagencyreviews.com, Trustpilot agent reviews
PlanNet rep fees (per its 2024 income disclosure, may change): $19.95 to start, $19.95 per month. Older reviews quote ITA startup around $179 (unverified, check current price).

PlanNet 2025 Income Disclosure: 16.04% of reps earned any commission; 83.96% earned none. Entry 'Rep' rank (92.52% of members) averaged $38.15 for the year. Sources: hostagencyreviews.com, plannetmarketing.com/en-us/Income-Disclosure
InteleTravel won a 'home travel agency of the year 2025' award per agent reviews (unverified).

FTC rule of thumb: any income or lifestyle claim must reflect what a TYPICAL person earns after expenses. Showing top earners or 'quit your job' lifestyle images without that is likely deceptive. Source: ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/business-guidance-concerning-multi-level-marketing

InteleTravel ITA cost per a 2025 review site: $179.95 to start plus $39.95/month (verify). PlanNet promotes a free personalized booking website and a 'Profit Guarantee' (company claim, terms unchecked).

Positioning recommendation: sell Jessica as a personal travel advisor (no extra cost, one person to call), NOT a 'travel club' or 'discount membership'. Keep the business opportunity on a separate page.

Stop spending your vacation planning your vacation.

Curious about becoming a travel advisor? Start with a 15-minute coffee chat, not a pitch.
Learn the travel business with a team that trains you, not pressures you.
Already the friend everyone asks for trip advice? Here's how advisors do it.
top_features: Real human travel advisor (Jessica) with photo, story and phone number
Free trip-planning consult / quote request form (dream trip quiz)
Access to 110+ travel suppliers: cruises, resorts, all-inclusives, Disney, tours (verify list)
Price-check promise: 'send me the Expedia link, I'll see if I can match or add perks' (only if she can deliver; guess)
Real client reviews and trip photos
Who I help: families, couples, groups, destination weddings, girls trips
Business opportunity page with honest costs and a link to the official PlanNet income disclosure
Training and team support explained, with a no-pressure 'coffee chat' booking button
pain_points_buyer: Planning a trip takes hours of tabs and reviews and still feels risky
Fear of overpaying or missing a better deal
Fear of being sold to by a friend in an MLM ('is this a pyramid thing?')
'Why not just use Expedia?' Doubts an agent adds value or saves money
No one to call when something goes wrong (cancelled flights, hotel problems)
Fear of scam travel clubs that charge big fees for fake discounts (real history: BBB and state AG cases)
pain_points_joiner: Pyramid scheme stigma and fear of looking foolish to friends and family
Fear of pestering friends or losing relationships
Burned before by another MLM, fear of failing again
Monthly fees that add up while earning little or nothing (most PlanNet reps earn under $40/year per the company's own disclosure)
Not knowing how to sell, market or get clients
Wants travel perks and flexibility but has limited time (moms, side-hustlers, near-retirees)
compliance: No income numbers, no 'get paid to travel', no lifestyle claims (cars, quit your job).
Link the official PlanNet Income Disclosure on any opportunity page: https://www.plannetmarketing.com/en-us/Income-Disclosure
Do not claim 'wholesale' or '% off' savings without proof; advisors usually cost the client the same as booking direct.
